script.opening_words:
There's a Fidelity study, nobody can
quite find a copy of, but everyone in
finance has heard about it. The story
goes like this. Fidelity pulled the data
on their best performing accounts over a
decade. They wanted to know what the
winners were doing. The winners weren't
the day traders, they weren't the
spreadsheet guys, they weren't the guys
who read every earnings report. The
winners were the people who had died and
the people who had completely forgotten
the accounts existed. The study might
script.ending_words:
income or a smarter advisor. She just
turned on a few toggles in her 30s and
went back to her actual life. That's the
whole game. So, here's your homework.
Pick one, just one. Don't try to do all
10 this weekend. That's not lazy. That's
a different flavor of busy. Open a tab.
Pick the easiest one for your situation,
probably auto escalation or
TOD designations. Spend 30 minutes
setting it up tonight. Then, close the
tab, walk away. Go watch TV. Go on a
walk. Do anything other than check your
accounts. The default is set to broke.
Change the default. The money will
figure itself out from there.
